## Responsibility

The product's inside: domain model (versioned documents, rules, memory map, import index, run state machine, plans), ports, and use cases. No I/O of its own; adapters arrive through ports.

## Invariants

- Every persisted file is stamped with its header [[cite: packages/core/src/domain/versioned.ts:144 | "stamp(body: z.output<S>): DocumentHeader & z.output<S> {"]].
- Errors cross layers as one type [[cite: packages/core/src/domain/errors.ts:21 | "export class MetatorError extends Error {"]].

## Allowed dependencies

Only the pure libraries approved in ADR-0010 (enforced by MT-ARCH-003). Never runtime, cli or plugins (MT-ARCH-002); tests may use `@metator/testing`.

## Pitfalls

- Changing a document schema in place breaks files users already have: add a version and an `upgrade` (MT-CODE-003).
- A new setting is an option in the registry (`domain/option-registry.ts`), not a field of `MetatorConfig`: one definition gives the CLI, the daemon and the app its type, default, scope and description (S1).
- `Bun` and `process` do not exist here (MT-ARCH-004); take what you need through a port.
